commitResults.messageTitle: Add person needed to be modified to add students
commitResults.messageBody:
Since TutorEasy has tutors as its target audience, the person class was
modified to include the attributes of a student. The attributes added
are subjects, cost and lesson. The subjects attribute is a set of
subjects that the student is taking, the cost attribute is the cost of
the lesson and the lesson attribute is the day and time of the lesson.
The add command was also modified to include these attributes when
adding a new student. The edit command was also modified to include
 these attributes when editing a student. The person card was also
 modified to display these attributes when viewing a student.

commitResults.messageTitle: The test cases were not updated
commitResults.messageBody:
I have made some changes to the test cases and also some minor
formatting changes to the code. The test cases are now updated to
reflect the changes made to the Person class.

To cover a larger scope of the Person class, I have added more test
cases to the PersonTest.java file. These tests include checking the
toString method and ensuring that all attributes of the Person class
are correctly represented in the string output.
Made changes to ensure that patch coverage can be 100%

Students can be found by name, tag, and class timing, but subject
search is missing.

Support find sub/KEYWORD with case-insensitive partial matching across
current enrolments and legacy subject-only records. Return each
matching student once and preserve address-book order.

Keep subject parsing separate and delegate other find modes to the
existing parser to minimize overlap with the pending find changes.

Add parser, predicate, and integration tests and document the syntax.

Verify tests and style checks on upstream master and a temporary
combination with the fetched heads of PRs #59, #62, and #64. The
combined source merges without conflicts and passes the same checks.

To allow people to search for persons by their subjects, I have added a
new command called "subjectsearch" which allows users to search for
persons based on the subjects they are associated with. This feature
enhances the functionality of the application by providing a more
targeted search option.

Integrate the merged class-management and documentation changes while
preserving subject search and its tests.

The merge applies without conflicts. Verify the combined branch with
the full test suite and main and test style checks.

commitResults.messageTitle: Tag commands: Add tag management workflow
commitResults.messageBody:
Students can store tags, but they cannot manage them incrementally.

Add tag and untag commands with index validation and duplicate checks.

Enforce tag format and count limits across parsing and storage.

Preserve insertion order so tag data and displays stay predictable.

Accept only -all for removing every tag and reject --all as invalid.
